newsitem.title: USA: US marketers see slim govt role in heat oil supply.
newsitem.headline: US marketers see slim govt role in heat oil supply.

text.p: Petroleum marketers rejected an idea by Northeastern lawmakers to induce the government to beef up heating oil stocks ahead of winter, but instead said agencies, if necessary, could help ease a supply crunch by waiving certain transportation and tax regulations, a marketer lobbyist said Thursday.

The suggestion was made at a meeting of the Petroleum Marketers Association of America held Wednesday in light of warnings from lawmakers and the Energy Information Administration that heating oil inventories are far below normal for this time of year.
